cases.title: A plausible near miss is withheld, and the two passages show why
cases.question: What learning rate schedule did the Transformer use?
cases.explanation: Both passages discuss optimisation, so retrieval found candidates. The calibrated top probability (0.161) is below the fitted threshold (0.255), so the server withheld an answer before writing one. The competing passages are shown so the decision can be inspected.

passages.text: We used the Adam optimizer with beta1 = 0.9, beta2 = 0.98 and epsilon = 1e-9.
The learning rate was varied over the course of training according to a fixed formula.

cases.kind: Claim removed by the citation check
cases.title: A fluent claim is removed because its quote is not in the cited passage
cases.question: How many papers are in the corpus?
cases.verdict: Claim removed: quote not found in the source
cases.explanation: The model returned a claim with a real source, but the quote it supplied does not appear in that passage. The server removes the claim before the caller sees it and records the quote mismatch. The proposed quote and the actual passage are shown side by side.

passages.text: The corpus contains five arXiv papers and two GAO reports.
Proposed quote (not found): “The corpus contains twelve arXiv papers.”

cases.kind: Meaning-only search missed; keyword search found it
cases.title: The rare term is invisible to meaning search and found by keyword search
cases.question: Which fixture term is found only by the keyword path?
cases.verdict: Hybrid found the passage; meaning-only search did not
cases.explanation: Meaning-only search ranks four adjacent passages above the reference and never retrieves it. Adding keyword search puts the reference passage first; the merged ranking keeps it first, so the final context contains the evidence.

passages.text: Dense retrieval maps each passage to a single vector. (meaning-only rank 1 — wrong)
The refusal threshold is fitted on held out query passage pairs. (meaning-only rank 2 — wrong)
Hybrid retrieval finds the rare term “quokka” but vector only misses it. (keyword rank 1, merged rank 1 — reference)
